claims: Artemis 1 launched from NASA's Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
Artemis 1 was an uncrewed test flight of the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket and Orion spacecraft.
Artemis 1 splashed down in the Pacific Ocean on December 11, 2022.
The purpose of Artemis 1 was an uncrewed flight test to verify the SLS rocket and Orion spacecraft systems before crewed missions.
The launch vehicle of Artemis 1 was Space Launch System (SLS) Block 1.
The duration of Artemis 1 was 25 days, 10 hours, 53 minutes.
The Orion spacecraft performed two lunar flybys.
The Orion spacecraft traveled nearly 270,000 miles from Earth.
Artemis 1 was the first mission in the Artemis program aimed at returning humans to the Moon.
